title: Classify the funded chart-268 contact topologies
body:
## Mathematical scope

Fix the restored-side packet incidence edits and all original productive endpoints. Whole-map cut ranks eliminate 110 of 111 single grade-one additions. If 2678 is removed and up to two contacts are bought instead, all but one of the 51,660 funded ordered source/sink choices fail. The lone topology retains 421→1 and adds 0→19. These exclusions allow arbitrary payload recoding and acyclic order.

## Sources

Canonical main e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. #7830 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15 and #8006 4035f150285513852cab8d00b8bfc233c699ea0a. #8000 supplies prior fixed-incidence chart cuts. This package changes paid topology and reprices both callers.

## Validation

The cold package replays the native source, damaged control, all 409 exact rank witnesses and 51,660 candidate routes, and both directed complete price checks.

## Open next questions

Implement the full original map on 0→19 or change the incidence/endpoint contract. The cut survivor alone establishes no correct operator or κ gain.
